title: PvP Essentials Plus+ Christmas Edition
description: It is a remake of my other project PvP Essentials Plus+ that changes a lot of items and entities to be christmas themed.
body:
This Resurcepack is a remake of my other project PvP Essentials Plus+, it adds christmas themed items while keeping the vannila look and tweaks needed for PvP
PvP Essentials Plus+ Christmas edition core features:
- no pumkin blur
- smaller Totem Pop
- smaller totem particles that are christmas themed
- no explosion particles
- No Vignette
- bright ores
- Low fire
- small items
- small totem and shield
- small block fire
- no fire smoke
- animated items
- animated blocks 
- christmas themed items and blocks
- HD shield
_______________________________________________________________________________________________
It is designed for PvP and survival. USE ONLY ON CHRISTMAS!
